title: Component id list
description: One id list under data/oracle/: the component lists under card/component/, and the platform list at data/platform.json. Each entry holds the id that the data references. For the lists whose values a paper shows, the word each language shows for the id lives under data/print/<lang>/card/component/. IDs are unique within a list and do not change when a value is corrected.

id.description: The stable identifier referenced by card or print data.
